results.title: Ghana Navy adds US V-BAT drones to a six-country fleet - Unmanned Africa
results.snippet: The Ghana Navy is to acquire six V-BAT vertical take-off drones from the American firm Shield AI, Janes reported. The deal would make the United States the seventh country to supply drones to the Ghana Armed Forces.
